messages:
dave-support: FWD from customer (tenant: NovaPay) — they flagged a dependency 'fast-json-parse' with CVE-2026-31415. Asking for our SBOM snippet, remediation ETA, and whether we can provide KMS/audit log evidence for SOC2. They said it's hitting Dedicated deployments behind a VPC.

sylvia-sec: Thanks — can you paste the CVE link and any logs they attached? Also confirm whether they saw any active exploitation or just an advisory. Which of our surfaces are affected (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private)?

dave-support: Paste from customer: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2026-31415. They said it's an RCE in fast-json-parse <=1.2.3. No signs of exploitation in their app, just intel. Confirmed Dedicated (reserved GPUs) + on-prem connector.

frank-engineering: Quick triage from runtime: we vendor fast-json-parse in the runtime image, currently pinned to 1.2.3. Upstream released 1.2.4 with patch and a small API-compatible backport. Impact: possible if untrusted JSON reaches our parsing code path — in hosted API we have additional sanitizers but Dedicated/private images will need patch. Proposed action: build patched runtime image with 1.2.4-backport, run CI, canary 10% for Dedicated clusters, full rollout 72h.

lisa-devex: For customer comms we should give an SBOM excerpt (files + hashes) and a short attestation note. I can redact internal paths. Also suggest telling them about the temporary mitigation (input sanitization) while we patch.

frank-engineering: Command I'm using to locate the lib in images:

```
# check vulnerable package in runtime image
docker run --rm runtime-image:sha256abc sh -c 'grep -R "fast-json-parse" /app || true'
```

frank-engineering: CI shows 2/3 integration tests passing on backport branch. Deploy pipeline kicked a canary build.

deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: runtime-patch-fast-json-parse branch -> canary build started. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/3892 :white_check_mark: (tests running)

ops-samir: I can extract KMS access logs for Dedicated tenants if needed, but note: for Private deployments customers typically manage their own KMS/HSM so we can only provide guidance unless they asked us to run in-tenant tooling. Need the NovaPay tenant ID and customer consent to pull logs. Also advise that audit-log exports might contain sensitive metadata; will put in secure transfer.

sylvia-sec: For SOC2 evidence they usually want: 1) SBOM (component + hash), 2) timeline of detection -> triage -> remediation, 3) attestation that keys were not exfiltrated (KMS logs) or note about customer-managed KMS. I'll draft a short remediation attestation template. Frank/Samir/Lisa please review EOD so we can send to customer.

dave-support: Confirmed tenant id: novapay-568. Customer gave consent to pull Dedicated KMS and audit logs. I've told them we'll give an ETA of ~72 hours and share SBOM excerpt.

ops-samir: Starting log extraction for novapay-568 now. ETA ~4 hours to produce redacted export (90-day window). Will upload to secure S3 path and ping here.

lisa-devex: I'll prepare the SBOM excerpt and a short public-facing FAQ entry about what to expect during dependency patches (how we redact, expected ETA, and how this affects Dedicated vs Hosted).

frank-engineering: Plan summary: build + CI (12h), canary (24h), full rollout (48-72h) assuming no regressions. Blocking: need infra windows for Dedicated clusters and QA sign-off.

sylvia-sec: I'm drafting the attestation. One ask: include the CVE id and exact package version we patched, and whether we applied a hotfix or required customer-side action. I'll include a note about key custody for Private deployments.

dave-support: Customer replied: appreciated — asked if we can provide a short signed attestation for their auditor. Who signs?

sylvia-sec: I'll sign the attestation as Security Lead once reviewed by Frank and Samir. :thumbsup:

ops-samir: Upload complete: s3://secure-exports/novapay-568/kms-audit-2026-03-15-redacted.tar.gz. Shared link with dave-support.

frank-engineering: Canary looks healthy after 6h, rolling to 50% now. No perf regression observed.

lisa-devex: SBOM excerpt uploaded to the secure folder and KB draft in PR: https://docs.internal/kb/dep-response/PR-412.

sylvia-sec: Attestation draft uploaded: https://secure-docs/internal/attestations/novapay-568-fast-json-parse-2026-03-15.md — please review.

dave-support: Sending to customer now with ETA 72h and attestation draft. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround. :clap:
